ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: The visible ventral surface exhibits an approximate 65:35 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels to high-intensity (white/off-white) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The left lobe is characterized by a dominant dark contiguous region with a localized high-intensity white patch at the distal tip. acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular calcified growth at the distal tips of both lobes, creating a non-linear, high-relief topography against the water background.
other_distinctive_markers: A single, high-contrast dark circular mark is located within the white field of the right lobe's ventral surface.
